name: AI Tool Trek
conditions: Free Pack ($0) requires adding their partner link — AI Tool Trek — to your homepage for submission approval.
Free submissions are reviewed within 72 hours and listed within 15 days.
The listing is removed if the backlink is removed ('Your submission will be removed once the backlink is removed').
requirements: AI tools; the directory lists 3500+ AI websites and tools across categories like Text & Writing, Image, Chatbot, Coding, and NSFW.
The on-page submission form asks only for Website Name and Website URL at the top level.
preparation: The backlink AI Tool Trek live on your homepage before submitting on the Free Pack.

Plan decision: Free (backlink, 72h review / listed within 15 days) / Fast Track $19.9 (listed within 24h, 5+ dofollow backlinks, featured badge, one update within 7 days, lifetime) / Unlimited Pack $39.9/mo (unlimited submissions for agencies).
workflow: Pick the submission lane (Free / Fast Track / Unlimited).
Fill Website Name and Website URL and submit.
Free: add the partner link to your homepage first, then wait for 72h review and listing within 15 days.
Paid: checkout, then the listing goes live within 24 hours.
watchFor: Explicit clawback: 'Your submission will be removed once the backlink is removed' — the free listing is permanently conditional.
Contact email is Cloudflare-obfuscated ([email protected] pattern).
Unlimited Pack is a $39.9/mo recurring subscription aimed at agencies — not needed for a single product.
DR 52 'certified' claim links to an Ahrefs checker — self-reported marketing metric.
Sponsored placements (e.g. GPTScribe) occupy the top of the submit page.
countsAsLive: The tool appears in the aitooltrek.com directory under its category with a reachable detail page and outbound link.
unknowns: Whether the minimal Website Name/URL form expands after the first step (only two fields were visible).
How the backlink is re-verified over time.
